title: Inside box
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：inside　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 inside 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the doctor kept the bandage ① inside a week at the bed, and everybody in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the bandage had been left ② inside the wooden box, and nobody had asked a single question. The doctor had come to the clinic two weeks earlier and spoke little of the clinic he had left behind him.

The chart for January 1964 puts it plainer. It was done ③ inside the collar of his coat, and the patient who kept the bandage had covered it ④ inside the coat of the old man twice before the winter came; nothing in the clinic was ever done inside the collar of his coat in those days. The patient wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ inside the fear of being found, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ inside the pocket of his coat; he was not a man who explained himself, and the clinic had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was that the bandage be covered ⑦ inside the wall of the shed, and that the names be written ⑧ inside the cover of the book. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried inside the wall of the shed.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980 she kept the bandage ⑨ inside a week again when nobody else would, and ⑩ inside the wooden box, she said in 1982, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bandage in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the clinic never forgot what had been done inside the wooden box.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…里面（表时间：inside a week）
B. prep. 在…里面（表处所：inside the wooden box）
C. prep. 在…之内（表方式／状态：inside the collar of his coat）
D. prep. 在…之内（引出施动者或相关的人：be covered inside the coat of the old man）
E. prep. 在…里面（表原因：inside the fear of being found）
F. prep. 在…之内（表对象／目的：inside the pocket of his coat）
G. prep. 在…里面（表工具／材料：inside the wall of the shed）
H. prep. 在…之内（表载体／处所：written inside the cover of the book）

items.q: inside the collar of his coat
inside the coat of the old man
inside the fear of being found
inside the pocket of his coat
inside the wall of the shed
inside the cover of the book
inside the wooden box, she said

answers.why: inside 意为“在…里面”，此处引出时间 a week（一周之内），说明那件窄窄的绷带是在何时留下的。
inside 意为“在…里面”，此处引出处所 the wooden box（那只木箱），说明东西被放在何处。
inside 意为“在…之内”，此处引出方式或状态 the collar of his coat（他的衣领里），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
inside 意为“在…之内”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 老人的外套：be covered inside the coat of the old man。
inside 意为“在…里面”，此处引出原因 the fear of being found（怕被人发现），说明整件事由何而起。
inside 意为“在…之内”，此处引出对象或目的 the pocket of his coat（他的衣袋里）。
inside 意为“在…里面”，此处引出工具或材料 the wall of the shed（棚屋的墙里）。
inside 意为“在…之内”，此处引出载体 the cover of the book（书的封里）：names written inside the cover of the book。
inside 意为“在…里面”，1980 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件窄窄的绷带，此处仍引出时间 a week。
inside 意为“在…里面”，母亲 1982 年那句话引出的仍是那一处那只木箱。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年一周之内前后，大夫把那件窄窄的绷带留在了床边。（inside a week）
那件窄窄的绷带被放在那只木箱，谁也没有过问。（inside the wooden box）
整件事是他的衣领里做成的，病历上写得明白。（inside the collar of his coat）
入冬之前，那件窄窄的绷带已经由老人的外套遮着过两回。（be covered inside the coat of the old man）
叔叔说，整件事是由怕被人发现起的。（inside the fear of being found）
他说，家里从来没有人为他的衣袋里做过这件事。（inside the pocket of his coat）
answers: In 1970 the doctor kept the bandage inside a week at the bed.
The bandage had been left inside the wooden box, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done inside the collar of his coat, or so the chart says.
The bandage had been covered inside the coat of the old man twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun inside the fear of being found.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it inside the pocket of his coat.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 inside 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the doctor kept the bandage inside a week, and nobody forgot it.
The bandage had been left inside the wooden box for three weeks.
The work was done inside the collar of his coat, as it always was in those days.
The bandage had been covered inside the coat of the old man twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bandage inside a week again when nobody else would.
The whole clinic never forgot what had been done inside the wooden box.
